verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents that agent memory is 'persistent' and 'editable by you' (docs-16), and separately states chat data is stored locally by default (docs-44), suggesting a local, user-editable memory model. However, there is no explicit documentation of inspecting a memory store, deleting entries, or the storage being in an open/portable file format. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API for viewing and deleting memory records, confirmation the memory store itself (not just chat) is local, and documentation of the storage format as open/inspectable.
